entries.title: Psalms 96:1
segments: ¶O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 96:2
segments: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

entries.title: Psalms 96:3
segments: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

entries.title: Psalms 96:4
segments: For the LORD [is] great, and greatly to be praised: he [is] to be feared above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 96:5
segments: For all the gods of the nations [are] idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 96:6
segments: Honour and majesty [are] before him: strength and beauty [are] in his sanctuary.

entries.title: Psalms 96:7
segments: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

entries.title: Psalms 96:8
segments: Give unto the LORD the glory [due unto] his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts. {due...: Heb. of his name}

entries.title: Psalms 96:9
segments: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth. {in the...: or, in the glorious sanctuary}

words.text: . {in the...: or, in the glorious sanctuary}

entries.title: Psalms 96:10
segments: ¶Say among the heathen [that] the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

words.text: that it shall not be moved

entries.title: Psalms 96:11
segments: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof. {the fulness...: or, all it containeth}

words.text: thereof. {the fulness...: or, all it containeth}

entries.title: Psalms 96:12
segments: Let the field be joyful, and all that [is] therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

words.text: , and all that [is] therein: then shall all the trees

entries.title: Psalms 96:13
segments: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
